  Candidates: [{"adr":"ADR-0011","items":[{"section":"state_ownership","name":"graph_state_block","entry_yaml":"  - state: graph_state_block

    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    interface: "src/shared/graph/graph_ids.gd constants (loops, node kinds, port types, edge kinds, modes, states, bands, seam states, boundary, section kind, load tier/subtype, trace kind, subject kind (NODE 1, EDGE 2, COMPARTMENT 3, SEAM 4, OPENING 5), cause, medium, acoustic; ALARM_CAPABLE_MASK, STATE_NONE) plus assets/data/graph/ids.lock.json in the ADR-0007 ledger format"
    write_access: append-only by reviewed code change

      - docs/architecture/adr-0007-static-content-data-pipeline-and-stable-type-ids.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"graph_read_view","entry_yaml":"  - contract: graph_read_view

    pattern: direct_call
    producer: life-support-graph
    consumers:
      - failure-and-trail-system

      - interaction-system
      - save-load-and-versioned-format
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    signal_signature: "GraphView (getter-only facade from read_view): step_no() = floor_div(clock.tick(), GRAPH_STEP_TICKS); typed scalar getters with documented not-live sentinels and the guards node_live/edge_live/compartment_live (compartment_p/p_o2/t/bands, node_state (STATE_NONE -1 when not live)/hp/load_subtype/served_pm (the persisted n_served)/run_pm/stock_pm, edge_state/hp, opening_area, section_of, section_dormant); last_step_no() = the last step whose failure hook completed; compartments_in_section(section_id, out: PackedInt32Array) -> int; desc_* row getters and descriptors_of; alarm_sections(out: PackedInt32Array) -> int; failures(filter: FailureFilter, out: FailureSlice) -> void (store row indices, no allocation); true_value(kind, id) with kinds P, P_O2, T, STOCK_PM, SUPPLY, DEMAND, LOAD_PM, HP; pure, true values only"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"graph_mutator_value_types","entry_yaml":"  - contract: graph_mutator_value_types
    status: active
    pattern: direct_call
    producer: life-support-graph
    consumers:
      - modular-ship-assembly
      - ship-section-and-layout-data-model
      - interaction-system
      - web-map-and-transit
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    signal_signature: "caller-owned reusable RefCounted out/in objects with preallocated packed buffers: JoinPlan (inputs section_a, section_b, q, l_seam, pair_*, open_*; outputs res_*), WeldResult {seam_id, opening_count, opening_ids}, SectionBases {node_base, edge_base, comp_base} (ADR-0013's record in src/sim/layout/views/; InstantiateResult is deleted), SalvageRecord {def_id, hp, state, hp_cap, patched_at_step}, FailureFilter, FailureSlice {idx, count}; ADR-0012 owns can_join semantics"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"graph_room_source_port","entry_yaml":"  - contract: graph_room_source_port
    status: active
    pattern: direct_call
    producer: ship-section-and-layout-data-model
    consumers:
      - life-support-graph
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    signal_signature: "@abstract RoomSource {room_volume_tiles(room_ref) -> int (-1 unknown), room_exposed_tiles(room_ref) -> int}; implemented by Layout's LayoutRoomSource (layout.room_source() is passed to GraphModule.setup); overrides write the explicit -> int and return on all paths; test fakes are hand-written extends RoomSource classes in tests/support (ADR-0010 3.5), not gdUnit4 mock(); read in post_restore and ensure_derived only"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"graph_layout_port_adapter","entry_yaml":"  - contract: graph_layout_port_adapter
    status: active           # ADR-0011 and ADR-0013 are co-accepted (mutual ports)
    pattern: direct_call
    producer: life-support-graph
    consumers:
      - ship-section-and-layout-data-model
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    signal_signature: "GraphLayoutAdapter extends LayoutGraphPort (src/sim/graph/graph_layout_adapter.gd, outside ports/ because ARCH-05 requires every file under ports/ to be @abstract), exposed as graph.layout_port() and passed to LayoutModule.bind_graph by the composition root: check_instantiate_section(views, section_id, template_id, kind) -> StringName; instantiate_section(scope, section_id, template_id, kind, out: SectionBases) -> int (M1; its only caller is Layout LM1); opening_into(edge_id, out: OpeningRead) -> bool (door_state derived from area); seam_openings_into(seam_id, out: SeamOpenings) -> bool (socket_plan.openings order, valid after restore); section_counts_into(section_id, out: SectionCounts) -> bool (template-range counts, stub_count, tombstoned; persisted columns only); allocation-free, caller-owned outs"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"graph_payload_shape","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: graph_payload_shape
    status: active           # ADR-0011 is Proposed
    api: "snapshot payload is one String-keyed Dictionary: hdr (Dictionary of 17 ints built from the _h_* members of GraphState) plus one nested Dictionary per table (nodes, ports, edges, comps, seams, sections, queues, defs) mapping column name to a duplicate() of the packed column; any table/column/header rename or re-type is a schema_version bump with a committed GraphSchema fingerprint"
    not: "StringName payload keys; live column references; derived caches or diagnostics counters in the payload; flat dotted keys"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    reason: "ADR-0006 type walk rejects StringName; the hash is over sorted keys; one persisted-field check per class"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"graph_unit_system","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: graph_unit_system
    status: active
    api: "int64 for conserved/extensive quantities and counters, int32 for ids, step stamps, bp, permille, W and short physical quantities (range-checked before store), uint8 for enums and flags; all time stamps in Graph steps (step_no = floor_div(T, GRAPH_STEP_TICKS)); every product below 2^62 by the D.13 boot assertion; division only through IntMath; typed mini/maxi/clampi/absi/signi"
    not: "floats, Vector2i, bare / or %, a file-level integer_division ignore, kernel ticks in stored stamps"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    reason: "Determinism, cross-platform hashes and silent 32-bit truncation (ADR-0005 P9, P17)"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"graph_dirty_key_kinds","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: graph_dirty_key_kinds
    status: active
    api: "KIND COMP 1, BAND 2, NODE 3, EDGE 4, DESC 5, LOOP 6, SEAM 7, TOPO 8, SECTION 9; L/ key id = (loop << 24) | anchor; F/ key id = (subject_kind << 28) | subject_id (one per subject); quanta from GraphTuning; last-emitted buckets derived and seeded in post_restore; quiet_writes_allowed true"
    not: "per-field or per-step continuous keys; per-descriptor F keys; String keys"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    reason: "Keeps the design cascade at 38 keys and the packing inside the 32-bit key id"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
      - docs/architecture/adr-0004-change-notification-and-dirty-keys.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"graph_fault_domain_codes","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: graph_fault_domain_codes
    status: active
    api: "domain 3 local codes 1..26 append-only (NOT_IN_SCOPE, RESTORE_* x14 with first-failure-wins precedence including 26 RESTORE_HOOK_CURSOR, STRUCT_* x6, ID_SPACE_EXHAUSTED, DESC_STORE_OVERFLOW, STEP_RANGE, SATURATION, and 25 HOOK_CURSOR, the runtime guard raised by ADR-0012); GRAPH_BOOT_* are domain-2 names in ContentFaults"
    not: "reuse or renumbering; restore failure by return value or clamp"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    reason: "ADR-0003 section 6 delegates the owner code list to the system ADR"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"graph_owned_constants_rule","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: graph_owned_constants_rule
    status: active
    api: "Graph tunables are lowercase accessors of the frozen GraphTuning equal to registry LOCKED rows; MAX_DIRTY_KEYS, TICK_RATE, HYPOXIA_PP, DECOMP_P, COLD_DMG_ONSET_MC, HEAT_DMG_ONSET_MC never appear as symbols in src/sim/graph or src/sim/suit (READ-03 token list forbidden_symbols/graph.json)"
    not: "redeclaring a registry constant as a literal or const in Graph or Suit"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    reason: "One source of truth for tunables (TR-lsg-043)"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"graph_hook_products_persisted","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: graph_hook_products_persisted
    status: active
    api: "n_served (permille), n_draw (dJ per step), CABLE e0 (net load, W, non-negative magnitude), power_use_w0..w4 (collectively power_use_w5) and the schedule in force sched_div/sched_off_* (collectively sched) are persisted and written by ADR-0012 phase 2 only; served_pm(id) reads n_served; post_restore re-derives P, p_o2, o2_pm and trend and never served, draw or a cable's net load; hdr.last_step_no is the last step whose failure hook completed; restore step 13 checks the hook cursors against the stored sched and the clock"
    not: "deriving served, draw or cable load in post_restore; persisting the intensive atmosphere values; reading served_pm from a cache"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    reason: "A restore between the power hook and the atmo or failure hook cannot rebuild the hook products from post-phase state (ADR-0012 section 11)"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"graph_stale_id_sentinels","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: graph_stale_id_sentinels
    status: active
    api: "a non-live id (negative, unknown, at or above its counter, tombstoned) is not a fault: Class B mutators no-op, Class A checks return UNKNOWN/NOT_*, GraphView getters return the documented sentinel (node_state/edge_state GraphIds.STATE_NONE -1, node_kind/section_of -1, compartment_t GraphLimits.TEMP_NONE, magnitudes 0) and node_live/edge_live/compartment_live are the guards; every slot and index is validated before the first column write because an out-of-bounds packed write is a SCRIPT ERROR that aborts the function"
    not: "a blanket neutral 0 (node_state 0 is OK); indexing an array with an unchecked id"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    reason: "A dead or never-allocated lamp must not read as healthy; a script error gives no fault and no rollback in release"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"performance_budgets","name":"graph_state_snapshot_size","entry_yaml":"  - system: graph_state_snapshot_size
    status: active           # ADR-0011 is Proposed; synthetic-fixture estimate, release measurement pending (S3)
    budget_ms: 0
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    notes: "Column set of ADR-0011 section 3 measured 29.7 KB canonical bytes (29,674) at 105 nodes, 150 edges, 270 ports, 14 compartments (probed 2026-10-29, value-independent, synthetic defs of 60 offsets and 1,500 utf8 bytes); the persisted hook products (n_served, n_draw, 8 bytes per node row, plus the power-use window) bring the loaded roster to about 30.5 KB (about 30.7 KB with sched), about 4.6 percent headroom against the 32,000-byte ceiling of TR-lsg-036 (ADR-0012); reached near 111 nodes and 159 edges; a lifetime-worst fixture (every socket welded and cut RAGGED once) is a Validation item and lever 1 (fluid-stamp side table) is pre-committed; levers in section 3.11. budget_ms is not applicable (size budget)."
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: """},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"graph_field_write_outside_writer_files","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: graph_field_write_outside_writer_files
    status: active           # needs ADR-0010 OWN-01 (directory globs, per-member entries) and the ARCH-06 exemption (foundation ask 1)
    description: "Assignment or a mutating call on a GraphState/GraphCaches/GraphScratch underscore-prefixed member outside the writer matrix of ADR-0011 section 12.1 (GraphState: propagate/**, graph_mutators.gd, graph_restore.gd; GraphCaches: graph_derived.gd, plus propagate/** for the intensive values, descriptor store and alarm_sections, plus propagate/** and graph_mutators.gd for the last-emitted buckets; GraphScratch: propagate/** contents, graph_derived.gd sizing and the stack/queue buffers)."
    why: "GDScript has no private fields; one writer set keeps the dirty-key and touch-serial discipline checkable."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"graph_id_reuse_renumber_or_compaction","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: graph_id_reuse_renumber_or_compaction
    status: active
    description: "Reusing, renumbering or decrementing a Graph node, edge, seam or section id or counter, compacting tables in the MVP, or changing a persisted GraphIds value (append-only; ids.lock.json)."
    why: "Layout bases, Interaction subjects, Perception refs and saves hold these ids."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"graph_holder_static_var_or_state_backref","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: graph_holder_static_var_or_state_backref
    status: active           # lexical part needs ADR-0010 OWN-01 (static var scan)
    description: "A static var in GraphState, GraphCaches, GraphScratch or GraphDiag, or a field of type GraphState in GraphCaches, GraphScratch, GraphDiag or GraphView."
    why: "Reflection does not list a static var and it is shared by every instance, including the restore scratch object; a back-reference makes a RefCounted cycle that leaks."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"graph_derived_value_in_payload","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: graph_derived_value_in_payload
    status: active
    description: "Putting a derived cache, scratch buffer, diagnostics counter or StringName key in the graph.state snapshot payload, or persisting the intensive atmosphere values P, p_o2, o2_pm or trend (the hook products n_served, n_draw, CABLE e0 and power_use_w0..w4 are persisted by design)."
    why: "Hash stability, TR-lsg-004/038/039, ADR-0006 type walk."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"existing entries gaining ADR-0011","entry_yaml":"- fault_domain_table (state_ownership, ADR-0003): add docs/architecture/adr-0011-life-support-graph-data-model.md (domain 3 local code list written here)
- block_persistence_payload (interfaces, ADR-0006): add this ADR (nested String-keyed Dictionary of duplicated columns; restore precedence)
- dirty_key_encoding (api_decisions, ADR-0004): add this ADR (Graph kinds and the L/ and F/ packing)
- id_ledgers (state_ownership, ADR-0007): add this ADR (graph ids.lock.json spaces)
- foreign_private_member_access (forbidden_patterns, ADR-0010): add this ADR (writer/reader file exemption request, with directory globs and per-member entries)
- packed_array_exposed_or_setter_tracked (forbidden_patterns, ADR-0010): add this ADR (alarm_sections and failures use caller-owned buffers)
- integer_division_convention (api_decisions, ADR-0005): add this ADR (no file-level ignore in src/sim/graph)"}]},{"adr":"ADR-0013","items":[{"section":"state_ownership","name":"layout_state_block","entry_yaml":"- state: layout_state_block
    status: active           # ADR-0013 is Proposed
    owner_system: ship-section-and-layout (src/sim/layout/)
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md
    interface: "block layout.state (SIM, WORLD, SHARED, restore_after []): closed payload of parallel columns - counters{next_section_id,next_body_id,next_room_id}, bodies{body_id,origin_section_id,state}, instances (14 columns incl. template_id Array[String] and geometry/visual/structure hash int32), sockets (sparse non-FREE), welds (int64 times); derived caches (lookups, leaf cache, versions, grid) in LayoutDerived, never persisted or hashed; restore() is byte-identical and never rewrites a stored hash (diagnostics only; hashes refreshed in LM2 when an instance first gets history)"
    write_access: layout-mutators-only (LM1-LM4 and restore); socket state only inside LM2/LM3; stored hash refresh only inside LM2
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"state_ownership","name":"layout_id_counters","entry_yaml":"- state: layout_id_counters
    status: active
    owner_system: ship-section-and-layout
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md
    interface: "section_id, body_id, room_id allocated by Layout from persisted counters (first id 1, dense: section_id == row+1, body_id == row+1, room_id contiguous per instance), never reused or renumbered, tombstones keep ids; caps section 2^20-1, body/room 2^31-1 checked in can_build/can_detach before any id is consumed; Graph owns node/edge/compartment (COMPARTMENT node ids, comp_base == node_base)/seam ids and returns SectionBases {node_base, edge_base, comp_base} stored per instance; the bsearch reverse lookup covers template-range ids only (stubs resolve via GraphView.section_of)"
    write_access: LM1 (section, body, room) and LM3 (body) only
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"interfaces","name":"layout_mutators","entry_yaml":"- contract: layout_mutators
    status: active
    pattern: direct_call
    producer: ship-section-and-layout
    consumers:
      - web-map-and-transit
      - modular-ship-assembly
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md
    signal_signature: "Four Class A mutators, no Class B: build_section(scope, template_id, kind, out: BuildResult)->int (Web Map init_world, INIT scope), attach_section(scope, socket_ref_a, socket_ref_b, seam_id, welded_at_T, out: AttachResult)->int (Assembly weld apply after Graph weld_join), detach_section(scope, seam_id, boundary_mode, out: DetachResult)->int (after Graph cut_detach), discard_section_geometry(scope, section_id)->int (Web Map only; invalidates versions; BM8 release_body follows in the same apply); pure checks can_build/can_attach/can_detach/can_discard(views, ...)->StringName (&\"\" = OK; reasons closed sets; can_attach has nine incl. COORD_LIMIT; can_build passes Graph reasons as GRAPH_<REASON>); preview_attach(a, b, out: AttachPreview) for {reason, hatch_one_sided, openings_count}; socket_plan canonicalised survivor-first; result records are caller-owned plain-var records with reset(), arrays filled in place with a count, valid until the next Layout call; socket_ref = (section_id << 4) | socket_index with SOCKET_INDEX_BITS declared in SocketRef"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"interfaces","name":"layout_graph_port","entry_yaml":"- contract: layout_graph_port
    status: active
    pattern: direct_call
    producer: life-support-graph (GraphLayoutAdapter extends the port; src/sim/graph/graph_layout_adapter.gd, exposed as graph.layout_port(); bound via LayoutModule.bind_graph after GraphModule.setup and before the registry freeze)
    consumers:
      - ship-section-and-layout
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md
    signal_signature: "@abstract LayoutGraphPort (src/sim/layout/ports/): check_instantiate_section(views, section_id, template_id, kind)->StringName; instantiate_section(scope, section_id, template_id, kind, out: SectionBases)->int; opening_into(edge_id, out: OpeningRead)->bool (false = unknown); seam_openings_into(seam_id, out: SeamOpenings)->bool; section_counts_into(section_id, out: SectionCounts)->bool (template-range counts, stub_count, tombstoned; persisted columns only); reads valid in APPLY, INIT, HOOK, post_restore; writer in APPLY and INIT; all reads allocation-free, caller-owned out; a call before bind_graph is an asserted defect; co-accepted with ADR-0011"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"interfaces","name":"layout_room_source","entry_yaml":"- contract: layout_room_source
    status: active
    pattern: direct_call
    producer: ship-section-and-layout (LayoutRoomSource extends RoomSource, src/sim/layout/layout_room_source.gd, exposed as layout.room_source())
    consumers:

    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"layout_snapshot_shape","entry_yaml":"- purpose: layout_snapshot_shape
    api: "Instances by reference to templates; dense parallel packed columns in ascending id order; no int-keyed Dictionary, no PackedStringArray, no Vector2i/Rect2i; template_id as typed Array[String] restored via per-element typeof==TYPE_STRING then Array[String].assign (type preservation not relied on); welded_at_T/cut_at_T as native PackedInt64Array; hashes stored int32 and compared with & 0xFFFFFFFF; rot_q byte column must be 0; byte columns range-checked on the decoded value before narrowing writes; restore uses has() and typeof() before any typed assignment; section_id == row+1, body_id == row+1"

    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"section_id_allocation_split","entry_yaml":"- purpose: section_id_allocation_split
    api: "Layout allocates section_id, body_id, room_id (persisted counters, first id 1); Graph allocates node/edge/compartment/seam ids and returns bases via M1 as SectionBases (M1's only caller is Layout LM1 through LayoutGraphPort); LM1 reads counters, calls Graph M1, appends rows and advances counters only on OK; Graph next_section_id follows Layout (max+1); setup order Layout.setup, GraphModule.setup(layout.room_source()), LayoutModule.bind_graph, registry freeze"

    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"weld_survivor_lower_body_id","entry_yaml":"- purpose: weld_survivor_lower_body_id
    api: "offset_b = offset_a + pos_a - pos_b with a the survivor-side socket; survivor = body with lower body_id regardless of argument order; welds[] canonicalised (section_a/socket_a = survivor side) and socket_plan/JoinPlan canonicalised survivor-first so graph.state seam rows are argument-order independent; reversed calls give byte-identical layout.state and equal whole-world state_hash; every built section starts on its own body so the weld relation is a forest; detach components enumerated in ascending section_id, new body origin = min section_id; one DetachPlanner shared by detach_preview and LM3; can_attach also refuses COORD_LIMIT (BODY_COORD_LIMIT) before GEOM_OVERLAP"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"template_hash_payloads","entry_yaml":"- purpose: template_hash_payloads
    api: "geometry_hash, visual_hash, structure_hash = Hash64.low32(Hash64.of_value(sub-payload)) computed once at catalog freeze; sub-payloads are Dictionaries of flat PackedInt32Array families in LY-4 field order (CSR for variable-length), structure_hash covers ordered key sequences and tile sets; all three persisted per instance; structure mismatch = LAYOUT_RESTORE_TEMPLATE_CHANGED always, geometry mismatch only with history; restore never rewrites a stored hash (geometry_changed_fresh and visual_changed are re-raised diagnostics); stored hashes are refreshed from the current template in LM2 when an instance first gets history"

    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"section_ledger_flat_compound_keys","entry_yaml":"- purpose: section_ledger_flat_compound_keys
    api: "assets/data/sections/ids.lock.json is one section_templates space with a flat pairs[]; template pair key <template_id>, room pair key <template_id>/<room_key>; class split by key shape and id boundary checked by SectionLedgerCheck in src/data/sections/; integers not persisted in layout.state"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"layout_doors_leaf_key","entry_yaml":"- purpose: layout_doors_leaf_key
    api: "layout.doors (divisor 1, offset 0, after []) derives leaf_w = width_px - floor_div(width_px*area, area_max) from Graph opening_into, clamps area (area_clamped diagnostic; in post_restore an area above area_max is LAYOUT_RESTORE_DANGLING, no clamp), bumps leaf_version/version at most once per section per tick (never static_version), opens layout.state once and marks LEAF/<section_id> (kind 4); LM2 seeds new LEAF closed without reading area; unknown opening leaves leaf closed; discard invalidates versions and restore calls new_epoch (version_epoch is the restore signal)"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"socket_state_write_outside_lm2_lm3","entry_yaml":"- pattern: socket_state_write_outside_lm2_lm3

    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"layout_reads_body_state","entry_yaml":"- pattern: layout_reads_body_state
    description: "Layout reading body.state (pose, velocity, actor positions, foot boxes) in a check, mutator, hook or read; foot boxes are caller arguments"

    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"graph_id_allocated_in_layout","entry_yaml":"- pattern: graph_id_allocated_in_layout

    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"layout_result_array_aliased","entry_yaml":"- pattern: layout_result_array_aliased

    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"fault_domain_table","entry_yaml":"fault_domain_table: add docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md (Layout is static domain 4, LayoutFaults codes 1-9)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"id_ledgers","entry_yaml":"id_ledgers: add docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md (section_templates nesting decided: flat pairs, compound keys)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"static_content_catalogs","entry_yaml":"static_content_catalogs: add docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md (SectionTemplates compiled rect accessors, emitter-placement accessors, three hashes)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"mutator_status","entry_yaml":"mutator_status: add docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md (four Class A mutators using can_* check prefix; ADR-0003 admits the prefix)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"dirty_key_marking","entry_yaml":"dirty_key_marking: add docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md (layout.state kinds SEC 1, BODY 2, SEAM 3, LEAF 4)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"canonical_encode_and_hash","entry_yaml":"canonical_encode_and_hash: add docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md (template hash sub-payload shapes)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"block_persistence_payload","entry_yaml":"block_persistence_payload: add docs/architecture/adr-0013-ship-layout-block-geometry-and-id-allocation.md (layout.state payload shape)"}]},{"adr":"ADR-0019","items":[{"section":"state_ownership","name":"controller_state_block","entry_yaml":"  - state: controller_state_block

The Adapter is the last child of its parent so its _input runs first"

Body reads octant and gait_effective only; Interaction and Assembly read intent_octant; Attention and Horror may name only get_loco_state (lint CTL-05)"

    referenced_by:

    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: "2026-10-29 (review: complete signatures)""},{"section":"interfaces","name":"input_source_port","entry_yaml":"  - contract: input_source_port
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    pattern: direct_call
    producer: engine-input-source (src/presentation/controller/input/engine_input_source.gd)
    consumers:
      - input-adapter
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    signal_signature: "@abstract InputSource with exactly ten abstract methods, all implemented by EngineInputSource and FakeInputSource (a partial implementation is a parse error), each override restating its return type and returning on every path (lint CTL-13): begin_frame, get_action_milli(action) -> int (ANALOG_UNITS), is_action_down, drain_edges(out: EdgeRing), cursor_px() -> Vector2i, wheel_net, focus_flags, pad_flags, apply_cursor_mode (on change, re-asserted on FOCUS_IN and PAUSED->RUNNING), warp_cursor (Input.warp_mouse, window pixels); every analogue crosses as an int and every position as Vector2i so a recorded InputTrace reproduces the Adapter; FakeInputSource lives in tests/support/"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: "2026-10-29 (review: ten methods, typed returns, cursor re-assert)""},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"input_sampling_and_edges","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: input_sampling_and_edges
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    api: "InputAdapter._input (added as the LAST child of its parent so it runs first; _input order is reverse tree order, process_priority does not affect it) latches ordered press/release records for key, mouse-button and pad-button events, wheel presses (pressed==true WHEEL_UP/DOWN only) and pointer events into a preallocated EdgeRing de-duplicated against a held-set, and submits nothing; InputEventJoypadMotion is continuous-only (no edge record); InputAdapter._process (INPUT_ADAPTER -100) drains the ring, polls Input.get_action_raw_strength for continuous families, derives stick and trigger edges once per frame with hysteresis, and is the only place submit() is called, in the order set_move_intent, set_aim, commands; the Adapter uses _input (not _unhandled_input) and is the only caller of get_viewport().set_input_as_handled() for action-bound events"
    not: "polling just_pressed/just_released alone (a same-frame press and release cannot be ordered, probed 2026-10-29); _unhandled_input latching; recording pad-axis motion as edges; calling set_input_as_handled as a Node method (it is Viewport's); _input or set_input_as_handled in any layer, HUD or debug overlay; submit from _input, a signal handler or _physics_process; input buffering (ACTION_BUFFER_TICKS 0)"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    reason: "Ordered edges are needed by latch-until-released, fresh-press and hold-cancel rules; a focused Control would otherwise consume a press before _unhandled_input; a later node handling an event first would starve the ring; pad-axis motion reports pressed on every event; one tick of latency"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: "2026-10-29 (review: E2, E3, E4, E7)""},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"input_device_identity","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: input_device_identity
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    api: "Devices are identified by event type (RawEvent.classify: InputEventKey, InputEventMouse*, InputEventJoypad*); every InputMap binding built in code, including a user-captured one (BindingFactory.from_capture duplicates the event, sets device = BINDING_ANY_DEVICE (-1) and clears pressed/echo), uses the any-device wildcard, and keyboard bindings use physical_keycode; the only numeric use of InputEvent.device is comparing a pad event with the stored active_pad variable"
    not: "event.device == 0 or any integer literal; comparison with DEVICE_ID_* constants; a binding left at its constructor device or stored from a captured event directly (a pad binding defaults to device 0 and matches only pad 0, probed 2026-10-29 on 4.7.2)"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    reason: "4.7 changed the keyboard and mouse device numbers and pads are numbered by enumeration; bindings keep their constructor or captured device"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: "2026-10-29 (review: E8 capture path)""},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"input_action_deadzone_nonzero","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: input_action_deadzone_nonzero
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    api: "BindingFactory registers every catalogue action with InputMap.add_action(name, ENGINE_ACTION_DEADZONE) where the constant is non-zero (engine default 0.5 or 0.2); MOVE_DEADZONE and AIM_DEADZONE are Adapter-level scalings over get_action_raw_strength, which ignores the engine deadzone; a boot lint fails when InputMap.action_get_deadzone is 0.0 for any catalogue action"
    not: "add_action(name, 0.0); reading Input.is_action_pressed for a gameplay decision on an analogue family"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    reason: "Probed on 4.7.2: with a 0.0 deadzone a centred stick (axis_value 0.0) and a trigger at rest report their action pressed in both directions (abs(0.0) >= 0.0)"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"chest_hand_point_read_time_getters","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: chest_hand_point_read_time_getters
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    api: "ControllerView.get_chest_x/get_chest_y/get_hand_x/get_hand_y(player_id) -> int return an absolute body-frame integer: BodyView.pos_x/pos_y(actor) plus CHEST_POINT[sheet][row] (or HAND_POINT) from the frozen ADR-0007 ControllerCatalog table injected through ControllerTuning, mirrored by facing, row from loco_state; computed on every read, O(1), allocation-free; ADR-0017 reads exactly get_chest_x/get_chest_y, get_aim_angle and get_loco_state"
    not: "a stored chest_sim/hand_sim written in controller.step (one tick stale against the foot origin); a Vector2i on the per-tick Emitter path; a second source of the offsets in the presentation sidecar"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    reason: "controller.step runs before body.integrate, ADR-0017 reads the apex after it; a read-time getter cannot lag, and the apex and occlusion origin agree by construction (ADR-0018)"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"aim_quantisation_and_mapping","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: aim_quantisation_and_mapping
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    api: "Mouse aim is computed once per frame as RenderLayout.mouse_to_world_aim(cursor_px, f_q) minus the fixed aim origin (BodyView.pos_x/pos_y(actor) + AIM_ORIGIN_Y), aim_q = posmod(roundi(theta * AIM_UNITS / TAU), AIM_UNITS) (round first, then posmod), sent as an int; the Adapter forms no picture-origin subtraction itself; the OS cursor is warped with Input.warp_mouse (window pixels) on a zoom edge using the stored cursor_off and on a source handover, with a virtual-cursor fallback (accumulated InputEventMouseMotion.relative) when the warp is a no-op"
    not: "mouse_to_world_view or pose_q in the aim path; a second picture-origin subtraction; a float reaching submit(); wrapping before rounding; Viewport.warp_mouse"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    reason: "pose_q contains the look-ahead, which is a function of aim; the open-loop f_q form cannot feed back"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: "2026-10-29 (review: scalar position, Input.warp_mouse, virtual cursor)""},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"intent_resync_rule","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: intent_resync_rule
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    api: "The Adapter keeps last_acked per intent kind and sets it UNKNOWN (one change-filter bypass, rate-limited to one per AIM_SEND_INTERVAL ticks) on five labelled triggers: not-ok intent result (STALE), kernel leaves PAUSED, LOADING to RUNNING (load_seq change), focus or pad return, body_of_actor change; the first RUNNING frame after any non-RUNNING frame resyncs at -100 so it lands in P2 of the first tick; the Adapter is silent while the kernel is not RUNNING; equivalence-harness fixtures that include controller.state snapshot from a rest intent or replay the resync submission"
    not: "per-tick held-state commands; resync from a kernel hook; a persisted last_acked; submitting while PAUSED"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    reason: "The simulation's intent must equal the player's hands within one tick of RUNNING at a fraction of the traffic"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: "2026-10-29 (review: harness input model, CT-49)""},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"input_context_machine","entry_yaml":"  - purpose: input_context_machine
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    api: "Adapter-local InputContextMachine holds exactly one of GAMEPLAY, CHART_TABLE, INSPECT_CARD, CHAT (CHAT is VS-B: enum value and matrix column reserved, transitions not implemented at MVP); the context x action matrix is data (assets/data/input/context_matrix.json, completeness check skips reserved columns) and the return table is code with one test per row; STAGGERED, DOWNED, DEAD and IN_POD force GAMEPLAY; CursorPolicy maps GAMEPLAY and INSPECT_CARD to MOUSE_MODE_CONFINED_HIDDEN and CHART_TABLE and CHAT to MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE, applied on change and re-asserted on FOCUS_IN and PAUSED->RUNNING; the Adapter holds no ControlHandle and the Chart Table layer's PauseGate issues request_pause"
    not: "a context persisted in a snapshot; a custom cursor image in gameplay; the Adapter calling the control plane"
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    reason: "Contexts are presentation; the simulation only sees the zero intent and cancel the Adapter submits on entry"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: "2026-10-29 (review: VS-B reservation, cursor re-assert)""},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"device_id_literal_compare","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: device_id_literal_compare
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    description: "InputEvent.device is never compared with an integer literal or a DEVICE_ID_* constant anywhere in src/ or tools/ (lint CTL-02); a comparison with a variable such as the stored active pad is allowed."
    why: "Godot 4.7 changed the keyboard and mouse ids from 0 to 16 and 32, and pad ids are enumeration indices."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"input_read_outside_adapter_files","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: input_read_outside_adapter_files
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    description: "Input.*, InputMap, InputEvent and subclasses, _input, _unhandled_input, _unhandled_key_input and _shortcut_input appear only in the files listed in tools/lint/config/allowlists/input_surface.json (input_adapter.gd, engine_input_source.gd, binding_factory.gd, raw_event.gd, dev_actions.gd); set_input_as_handled only in input_adapter.gd; get_mouse_position, warp_mouse, joy_connection_changed, focus_exited and the two focus notification constants only in engine_input_source.gd; the pipeline root, HUD, Chart Table layer, debug overlay, Instruments and Presenter read no device and define no _input (lint CTL-07)."
    why: "One door to the devices makes input replayable and keeps the Chart Table layer, pipeline root and HUD from forking their own input handling or starving the Adapter's ring."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0010-source-layout-static-typing-and-lint-enforcement.md
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"adapter_writes_block_or_reads_perception","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: adapter_writes_block_or_reads_perception
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    description: "The Input Adapter and the Avatar Presenter write no block and hold no ModuleFacet or WriteScope (lint CTL-01); no file under src/sim/controller/ or src/presentation/controller/ reads Attention, Sanity or PERCEPTION_OUT (get_view(&\"attention.state\"), AttentionView/SanityView, perceived(, PerceptionRef, true_value), the single allowed exception being the injected Attention mutator's push_stimulus in controller_noise.gd; the Controller Sim's Suit read-view requests are locomotion_cap and stowed_heavy only (lint CTL-08); mass_g, instance_mass_g, weight_class and salvage_yield never appear in the Controller (lint CTL-03)."
    why: "Input mapping, deadzones and aim source are HR-6 anchors that must be structurally unable to lie; carry speed is independent of mass; controller.noise must still be able to push its stimulus."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"controller_writes_body_position","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: controller_writes_body_position
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    description: "The Controller Sim writes no body.state field (pos_curr, pos_prev, sub, odometer); on a body edge controller.step clears only channel_ref, channel_face and channel_body; the position baseline and sub reset belong to Body's transfer mutators (ADR-0015: BM4 new side and BM5 reset pos_prev and zero sub; BM3 keeps sub and last_octant)."
    why: "PC-14 position ownership; a same-tick Controller write after a pod hop must not displace the arrival cell (TR-shipbody-048)."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"controller_derived_point_stored","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: controller_derived_point_stored
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    description: "The chest and hand points are never stored on a ControllerRow, in a snapshot payload or in a cache, and never returned as a Vector2i; they are read-time scalar getters over BodyView.pos_x/pos_y plus the ControllerCatalog offsets."
    why: "A value derived in controller.step is one tick stale against body.integrate and breaks apex and occlusion consistency (ADR-0017, ADR-0018)."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"input_action_zero_engine_deadzone","entry_yaml":"  - pattern: input_action_zero_engine_deadzone
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed
    description: "No InputMap action is registered with a 0.0 deadzone; BindingFactory uses a named non-zero ENGINE_ACTION_DEADZONE and a boot lint rejects action_get_deadzone == 0.0."
    why: "With a 0.0 deadzone a centred stick or a trigger at rest reports is_action_pressed true (probed on 4.7.2), corrupting the edge latch and the hold-mode cancel."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"performance_budgets","name":"controller_component_budgets","entry_yaml":"  - system: controller_input_adapter
    status: active           # ADR-0019 is Proposed; advisory, pending measurement on RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK
    budget_ms: 0.1
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    notes: "Adapter per rendered frame (sampling, quantising, focus scoring over 32 candidates, submitting) P99 on a release export; sibling advisory sub-budgets: controller.step 0.02 ms per actor per tick (ADR-0003 P3 share-ledger row: 0.16 ms for eight, pending S1; controller.noise has no separate figure, reported by S1 as a sub-counter), Avatar Presenter 0.1 ms per avatar per frame, PC_* diagnostics 0.01 ms per tick (dev only), the read-time chest/hand getters are charged inside the caller's budget, LocomotionStep 0.05 ms per actor per tick at 2,000 rects (ADR-0015); a miss logs and never fails a logic test (TR-pc-029)"
    referenced_by:
      - docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md
    added: 2026-10-29
    revised: "2026-10-29 (review: CT-20 ledger row)""},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"existing_entries_cited_by_adr_0019","entry_yaml":"Append docs/architecture/adr-0019-player-controller-split-and-input-contexts.md to referenced_by of these existing entries: interfaces command_submission, zoom_request, render_layout, presentation_facet, presentation_stage_order; api_decisions frame_order, lint_forbidden_token_list, source_layout; forbidden_patterns presentation_submit_without_handle, command_constructed_outside_kernel; interfaces owner_callable_contract and mutator_status (the four Controller mutators are Class A); forbidden_patterns cosmetic_phase_from_tick_counter, which also gains the exception clause 'AvatarFrames in src/presentation/controller/avatar/ may derive the avatar's tick-stepped loop frames (idle, work, stagger, down) from the committed tick T and a sim-held entry tick; no other presenter may read frame.T for phase' (owned by ADR-0001/ADR-0009, see Foundation asks 1); also referenced_by for the ADR-0018 beam light allow-list entry (put_light_origin) and the ADR-0015 BodyView position getters."}]},{"adr":"ADR-0012","items":[{"section":"state_ownership","name":"graph_hook_products","entry_yaml":"- state: graph_hook_products
  status: proposed  # ADR-0011 adopts the columns by ruling CT-04
  owner: life-support-graph
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  interface: "n_served (permille) and n_draw (dJ per step) per power consumer node, the net load of a CABLE edge (edge column e0) and the five-int header window power_use_w5, written only by propagate phase 2, canonical zero elsewhere; persisted so a restore on any tick equals the uninterrupted run"
  read_by: [emitter-state, suit, interaction, in-world-instruments, attention, failure-and-trail]
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"interfaces","name":"graph_propagation_hooks","entry_yaml":"- contract: graph_propagation_hooks
  status: proposed
  pattern: kernel_hook_chain
  producer: life-support-graph
  consumers: [suit, attention, emitter-state, sanity]
  signal_signature: "three HookDescriptors graph.propagate.power/.atmo/.failure, divisor GRAPH_STEP_TICKS, offsets from GraphTuning (0,2,4) each <= divisor-2, after chain with tolerates_stale true on both edges; step_no = floor_div(clock.tick(), graph_step_ticks); cursors last_step_power/_atmo/_failure and last_step_no (the failure hook's step; trails step_no by up to one step); stored schedule hdr.sched compared at the first run after a load"
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  not: "a fourth Graph hook; a before: edge; catching up a missed step"
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"interfaces","name":"graph_input_queue_drain","entry_yaml":"- contract: graph_input_queue_drain
  status: proposed
  pattern: queued_unconditional_channel
  producer: life-support-graph
  consumers: [emitter-state, interaction, suit, horror, attention]
  signal_signature: "M14/M15/M17 enqueue into persisted bounded queues and drain only in phase 0 of the first graph.propagate.power execution that follows the deposit in kernel order (INIT, then tick, P2 before P3, compiled schedule position); an INIT deposit drains at the first power-hook tick after LOADING to RUNNING; grant returned only through the persisted draw_grant table"
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  not: "synchronous apply of M14/M15/M17; a synchronous grant; a drain outside phase 0"
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"graph_write_disciplines","entry_yaml":"- purpose: graph_write_disciplines
  status: proposed
  api: "Every Graph phase declares per written column JAC (read start-of-phase values, write a GraphScratch accumulator, apply in one ascending loop that re-zeroes it), ALLOC (ascending-id allocation against a running balance) or OWN (own row only); phases iterate derived active lists and alias columns in locals; accumulators all-zero at hook exit; phase 0 closes out the intensive caches it touched"
  not: "next-column copy and swap for pairwise fluxes; iterating to convergence; recursion; catch-up; iterating a table or Dictionary in a phase; a total-amount accessor on GraphState"
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"graph_fairness_gate_function","entry_yaml":"- purpose: graph_fairness_gate_function
  status: proposed
  api: "graph_rules.gate_floor(hp_before, hull_or_seam, gate_open, hp_fail, breach_hp) and apply_loss(hp_before, loss, floor_hp): a floor applied at the moment of damage that limits the reduction and never raises hp; EXOGENOUS causes pass floor 0; the node/edge EXOGENOUS flag is the descriptor cause of the current episode"
  not: "a post-pass that rewrites hp; rate_pm or stress_pm read outside the damage phase"
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"graph_rng_subject_key","entry_yaml":"- purpose: graph_rng_subject_key
  status: proposed
  api: "plain stream graph.fail; RngFacet.draw(stream, counter) with counter (step_no << 26) | (kind << 24) | id, kind 0 node, 1 edge, 2 reserved compartment, id < GraphLimits.ID_MAX <= 2^24; burst test posmod_i(raw & 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, 1000) < burst_p_pm; no stored counter; no restore epoch"
  not: "draw_epoch for a Graph draw; a node id and an edge id sharing one subject field; an id field narrower than GraphLimits.ID_MAX; a float or bare % in the burst test"
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"api_decisions","name":"graph_derived_rebuild","entry_yaml":"- purpose: graph_derived_rebuild
  status: proposed
  api: "GraphDerived.ensure_derived is idempotent and never resizes (size_derived/size_scratch/size_descriptors run only in structural mutators and post_restore); called by every writer that changes topology (structural mutators, end of phase 9 after a connectivity change, post_restore); the hook head guard is defect-only and counts late_rebuilds; degrees and deg_max are phase-6 scratch, not cached"
  not: "lazy-only topology refresh; a read that pays a rebuild; a hook reading a half-applied topology; a resize on the hook path"
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"performance_budgets","name":"graph_hooks","entry_yaml":"- system: graph_hooks
  status: proposed
  budget_ms: 0.5
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  notes: "GRAPH_HOOK_BUDGET_MS spike share: P99 0.5 and max 1.0 on a release export on RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK; pass/fail on the maximum over the three hook ids (power, atmo, failure) reported separately, not the step divided by three; the Graph's row in the ADR-0003 P3 share ledger; pending S1/S0-f; if missed the number moves (TD), not the design"
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"performance_budgets","name":"graph_snapshot_restore","entry_yaml":"- system: graph_snapshot_restore
  status: proposed
  budget_ms: 0.5
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  notes: "snapshot(ctx) payload build at most 0.5 ms and at most 32 KB for the MVP ship (about 30.5 KB plus 40 bytes with the hook products); restore plus post_restore at most 2 ms; kernel integration world 3 ms/10 ms is the kernel's; pending S3"
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"graph_iterate_to_convergence_or_catch_up","entry_yaml":"- pattern: graph_iterate_to_convergence_or_catch_up
  status: proposed
  description: "No Graph phase iterates to a convergence condition, recurses, repeats a step or runs a missed step; one pass per loop per step"
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"graph_wall_clock_or_epoch_in_propagation","entry_yaml":"- pattern: graph_wall_clock_or_epoch_in_propagation
  status: proposed
  description: "No wall clock, restore_epoch, draw_epoch, float or bare % in src/sim/graph/; budgets are counted work units per commit and wall clock on hardware nightly"
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"forbidden_patterns","name":"graph_hook_product_cache_not_persisted","entry_yaml":"- pattern: graph_hook_product_cache_not_persisted
  status: proposed
  description: "A value read by a later Graph hook or another block between hooks must be persisted, recomputed at its single point of use from persisted state, or listed as a re-derived cache with a stated window (ADR-0012 section 11); the intensive atmosphere caches are closed out by phase 0 so they hold at every tick boundary"
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0012-graph-propagation-scheme.md
  added: 2026-10-29"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"kernel_p3_step_hooks","entry_yaml":"kernel_p3_step_hooks (performance_budgets, ADR-0003): add this ADR (the Graph's spike share and its P3 share ledger row)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"native_code_policy","entry_yaml":"native_code_policy (api_decisions, ADR-0010): add this ADR (ladder reconciliation, rung order for the Graph)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"dirty_key_encoding","entry_yaml":"dirty_key_encoding (interfaces, ADR-0004): add this ADR (emission schedule)"},{"section":"referenced_by_update","name":"packed_array_exposed_or_setter_tracked","entry_yaml":"packed_array_exposed_or_setter_tracked (forbidden_patterns, ADR-0010): add this ADR (accumulators are private scratch)"}]},{"adr":"ADR-0014","items":[{"section":"state_ownership","name":"rect_index_and_layout_versions","entry_yaml":"- state: rect_index_and_layout_versions
  status: active           # ADR-0014 is Proposed
  owner_system: ship-section-and-layout-data-model (LayoutDerived: RectIndex, LayoutVersions)
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0014-geometry-broadphase-and-occluder-source-seam.md
  interface: "derived per-body row table + dense CSR grid; per-section int64 version/static_version/leaf_version held in private columns (_version_col/_static_col/_leaf_col) read through bounds-guarded version_of/static_version_of/leaf_version_of getters (0 = no live section); version_epoch, tick-stamped changed_region (new_epoch resets stamp_tick to -1); read only through the SolidQuery and OccluderSource ports; never persisted, hashed or snapshotted"
  write_access: layout-only (rebuild_body/release_body/rebuild_all/set_extent/set_empty; LayoutVersions bump_static/bump_leaf/invalidate/stamp_*/new_epoch)
  referenced_by:
    - docs/architecture/adr-0014-geometry-broadphase-and-occluder-source-seam.md
  added: 2026-10-29
  revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"solid_query","entry_yaml":"- contract: solid_query
  status: active           # ADR-0014 is Proposed
  pattern: direct_call     # injected @abstract port
  producer: ship-section-and-layout-data-model (LayoutSolidQuery)
  consumers:
    - ship-body-and-interior-physics (via LayoutCollide, the ADR-0015 CollideSource adapter that holds a SolidQuery; the only permitted wrapper)
    - horror-entities (assumed to use the same CollideSource, ADR-0023)
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0014-geometry-broadphase-and-occluder-source-seam.md
  signal_signature: "SolidQuery.solid_in(body_id: int, ax0: int, ay0: int, ax1: int, ay1: int, out: QueryBuffer) -> int (count = out.count); canonical name (solid_in_into is synced to it); half-open input box, SOLID mask, current leaf state, body frame, OCCUPIED-span output (x0, y0, x1-1, y1-1); half-open consumers convert once inline: x1 = spans[4k+2] + 1, y1 = spans[4k+3] + 1; ascending rect_key, each once; overwrites out; empty box or unknown body returns 0 with out.status"
  referenced_by:
    - docs/architecture/adr-0014-geometry-broadphase-and-occluder-source-seam.md
  added: 2026-10-29
  revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"occluder_source","entry_yaml":"- contract: occluder_source
  status: active           # ADR-0014 is Proposed
  pattern: direct_call     # injected @abstract port; one instance for the world
  producer: ship-section-and-layout-data-model (LayoutOccluderSource)
  consumers:
    - emitter-state-and-light-exposure-query
    - 2d-lighting-and-occlusion (occluder builder; ADR-0018 and ADR-0028 read spans as occupied spans)
    - layout PROJECTOR (ADR-0034)
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0014-geometry-broadphase-and-occluder-source-seam.md
  signal_signature: "OccluderSource.rects_in(body_id, ax0, ay0, ax1, ay1, out: QueryBuffer) -> int (OCCLUDES_LIGHT mask, occupied spans); section_rects_into(section_id, mask, out: QueryBuffer) -> int (body frame, occupied spans, ascending key, empty-extent rows omitted; section-scene consumers subtract section_offset_x/_y); version/static_version/leaf_version(section_id) -> int (0 = no live section); version_epoch() -> int; changed_region_kind(section_id) -> int (ChangedRegion NONE/ALL/REGION/FRAME, simulation-side, current tick only, advisory after a restore); changed_region_box_into(section_id, out: RegionBox) -> bool; section_of_key(key) -> int; idx_of_key(key) -> int (IntMath against the stride). Polygon corners are (x0, y0) and (x1_occ+1, y1_occ+1); Layout applies no shift"
  referenced_by:
    - docs/architecture/adr-0014-geometry-broadphase-and-occluder-source-seam.md
  added: 2026-10-29
  revised: """},{"section":"interfaces","name":"query_buffer","entry_yaml":"- contract: query_buffer
  status: active           # ADR-0014 is Proposed
  pattern: direct_call     # caller-owned out record
  producer: ship-section-and-layout-data-model (src/sim/layout/views/query_buffer.gd)
  consumers:
    - ship-body-and-interior-physics
    - emitter-state-and-light-exposure-query
    - 2d-lighting-and-occlusion
    - horror-entities
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0014-geometry-broadphase-and-occluder-source-seam.md
  signal_signature: "QueryBuffer(initial_capacity): count (only valid length), status (OK/EMPTY_BOX/UNKNOWN_BODY/UNKNOWN_SECTION), keys PackedInt64Array, spans PackedInt32Array (4 per record x0,y0,x1-1,y1-1, occupied), flags PackedByteArray, cells_touched, candidates_tested, grew; public columns, no set( accessor; grow(min_capacity) is cold and geometric (maxi(min_capacity, capacity()*2)); a query overwrites"
  referenced_by:
    - docs/architecture/adr-0014-geometry-broadphase-and-occluder-source-seam.md
  added: 2026-10-29
  revised: """},{"section":"performance_budgets","name":"layout_solid_in_per_actor","entry_yaml":"- system: layout_solid_in_per_actor
  status: active           # pending S1 / SP-ENG-1 on a release export on RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK
  budget_ms: 0.05
  adr: docs/architecture/adr-0014-geometry-broadphase-and-occluder-source-seam.md
  notes: "not a separate ledger line: a share of ADR-0015's whole-hook body.integrate entry (0.05 ms per actor P99, 0.4 ms for eight), which includes solid_in, the clamp, the row copy and the dirty marks; S1 reports solid_in as a sub-counter (TR-section-016, 2,000-rect body); probed margin on the editor binary only (3.1 us), not a pass; per-commit gates are the deterministic cells_touched/candidates_tested counts"
  referenced_by:
